title: Custom eggless Diwali cakes for Granville and Merrylands families
summary:
Diwali brings three generations to one table. The cake has to work for all of them - no separate order for the grandmother who won't touch anything with egg in it.

Every cake we bake is 100% eggless. Not some cakes, not most cakes. Every single one, every single time. That's not a Diwali special - it's the reason Harris Park families have ordered from us since 2019.

Six sizes, 15 flavours including Rasmalai and Ferrero Rocher, any design you send through. Buttercream, fondant, or ganache. 48 hours minimum notice - that's what fresh baking actually takes, and Diwali week fills the fastest of any week we have.

Pickup from Wigram Street, five minutes from Granville and Merrylands. Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725. We speak Hindi and Gujarati too.
keywords: worried the Diwali cake won't suit a guest who can't eat egg
